scope: current workspace.laicms.com deployment; API-first session, user, site-list, and create-site client contract

session_and_sites.credentials: include in the already signed-in browser session
authenticated_evidence: RSC contains user.id and a site-list payload with data, pagination, and canCreate
login_required_evidence: login content returned instead of the workspace RSC contract
session_and_sites.user_id_source: RSC user.id; never derive it from email and never substitute an external auth-provider ID
session_and_sites.complete_list_rule: fetch every declared page and verify the unique site count equals pagination.totalDocs

login_handoff.after_user_login: run a fresh API preflight; never reuse the old response or old site selection

create_site.transport: Next.js Server Action over React Flight

client_action_arguments.name: string; required; min 2; max 50
client_action_arguments.description: string; optional; max 200; UI default is empty string

create_site.wire_body_for_plain_values: JSON array containing one input object, generated by React Flight encodeReply
create_site.observed_success_envelope: next-safe-action result; UI reads result.data and optional data.setupError
verification_after_authorized_creation: identify exactly one new site by before/after unique-ID difference
read back its slug and displayDomain
open its exact backend route and default frontend
do not infer success from HTTP 200 or a toast alone
not_verified_without_mutation: exact success data fields beyond optional setupError
cross-deployment stability of the action ID

transport_policy.browser_role: authenticated same-origin session transport for API fetches; not the default UI workflow
transport_policy.preferred_context: reuse an existing in-app-browser tab whose origin is workspace.laicms.com
transport_policy.normal_preflight: background credentialed fetch through the existing session
transport_policy.no_same_origin_context: a background transport tab may be created only to establish the same-origin execution context; do not foreground it or treat it as UI execution
transport_policy.visible_navigation_gate: only an API result classified as login_required may open and foreground /sign-in
